_note: Post-call analysis fields to configure in Retell. The backend reads them from call.call_analysis.custom_analysis_data (verify on the first real payload; mapping lives in backend/app/voice/webhooks.py).

intake.name: location_text
intake.description: Street and nearest cross-street or landmark, as the caller said it

intake.name: hazard_type
intake.description: Best match for what the caller describes

intake.name: danger_words
intake.description: Comma-separated danger phrases the caller used, e.g. trapped, car stuck, rising, sparking. Empty if none

intake.name: anyone_in_danger
intake.description: True if the caller says anyone is in danger or stuck

intake.name: callback_ok
intake.description: True ONLY if the caller clearly said yes to a follow-up call on this number. False if they declined, were unsure, or were not asked

callback.name: outcome
callback.description: Compared with the original report. Leave empty if the resident did not answer

callback.name: anyone_in_danger
callback.description: True if the resident says anyone is in danger or stuck

callback.name: summary
callback.description: One short sentence, e.g. 'water at the curb and rising'
